questions.text: First Mujadid was Hazrat Umar bin Abdul Aziz. Who was the second one?
questions.explanation: Low confidence: the "second Mujaddid" (2nd Hijri century) is usually given as Imam al-Shafi'i; the CSS Times compilation gave Ahmad Sirhindi, who is "Mujaddid Alf-e-Sani" (renewer of the 2nd millennium), a different idea. Source: CSS 2008 Islamiat past paper (cssprep.com.pk); key checked against the CSS Times 2005–2016 solved compilation.
